outcome.summary: 8/8 cases FAILED at research: every search provider failed in every case; all 8 answers are evidence-only degraded with ZERO blocks. The SRC-24 adapter pin (merged in PR #20, ~90 minutes before this run) broke every search API call.
outcome.rootCause: pinnedFetch dropped RequestInit.headers — the adapters' per-request User-Agent (required by the Wikimedia UA policy; 403 'Please set a User-Agent' otherwise) and accept headers never reached the API. Confirmed by a live probe: the exact adapter call shape returns 403 without init.headers and 200 with 3 results after the fix.
outcome.whyEveryProviderFailed: wikipedia 403s without a contactable UA (policy working as designed); marginalia's API also reject-shaped; the merged composition degraded to survivors until none remained — the typed every-provider-failed error, exactly as designed for this scenario
outcome.whatWorked: degradation honesty: all 8 answers truthfully reported evidenceOnly=true, degraded=true, zero blocks, no false groundedness; the run summaries carried the typed all-fail error; the kill-tree protocol was executed immediately post-run
